description.en: Five gradient cards rotate around a 3D ring, with mirrored backs, fine particle graphics and curved chromatic trails at the edges.
description.zh: 五张渐变卡片沿立体圆环旋转，背面镜像显示，搭配精细粒子图形和边缘弯曲色散拖影。

keywords: 渐变 卡片 环形 旋转 轮播 立体 粒子 球体 色散 弯曲 Basit gradient ring cards carousel 3d chromatic

discovery.caveat: 卡片内容为本地视觉演示；渐变与图形由程序独立绘制，WebGL 不可用时提供平面切换。

source.implementation: Three.js, Canvas and GSAP reconstruction with measured color fields and reference-derived white vector shapes. Rendering, typography, optical effects and interactions are implemented locally; no original author source code or reference video is included.
source.license: Original design and gradient/source license not supplied or verified. Reference footage stays internal; original images and source code are not redistributed.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Drag to rotate, or use arrow keys to choose a card. Space pauses rotation; Home and End select the first and last card.
instructions.zh: 拖动旋转，或用方向键切换卡片；空格暂停，Home 和 End 选择首尾卡片。
